newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Network in merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Network in merger pact.

text.p: Phoenix Network Inc said on Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to merge with privately-held US ONE Communications Corp, a Dallas, Texas competitive local exchange carrier.

The stock-for-stock exchange will be a merger of equals, the companies said, with Phoenix Network the surviving entity. Phoenix will distribute about 37,500,000 newly issued shares to the shareholders of US ONE.

US ONE owns and operates a national network of Lucent switches capable of both local and long distance service. Its investors have a total of $74 million in equity, Phoenix said. US ONE had been seeking investors or strategic partners to complete the build-out of its national network.
Phoenix said it has already converted more than five percent of its traffic to the US ONE network.
The deal is expected to close within three months. The combined companies would be based in Golden.
Phoenix is an inter-exchange carrier offering long-distance services, Internet access and other services. Its shares closed Tuesday at 2-3/16.
